text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Happy New Year, Trainer! 
I look forward to working with you again 
this year!"
choice_data_list: Same to you! This is the year that counts!
Same to you! This is our big year!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"It really is... 
Now that we've reached the Classic year, 
our ultimate goal, the Triple Tiara, is 
right around the corner."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I'll keep pushing myself in training 
heading into the Elfin Stakes before 
then!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Also... there's a phone call I'd like to 
make. 
Would you be there with me when I do?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"—I have an important announcement 
for everyone back home today."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I am going to take on the Tiara route... 
and become a Triple Tiara horsegirl!"

text_block_list.name: Local Residents
text_block_list.text: ""Whaaaat, really?!""

text_block_list.name: Local Residents
text_block_list.text:
""Triple Tiara...?"" 
""You know, that title you get when you 
win all three—"" 
""Wait, seriously?! That's huge!!""

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
"You can do it! We know you can! 
You've got this, Tact!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much. 
I promise I'll send wonderful news back 
home!"

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
"That settles it! 
We're all heading out to cheer for every 
single race!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...! But everyone, what about your daily 
work...?"

text_block_list.name: Earnest-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
"Aw, don't sweat it, we'll make it work. 
No way we'd ever miss our Tact's 
once-in-a-lifetime challenge!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you so much. 
I'll be waiting for you all!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Hehe...
choice_data_list:
Sounds like everyone's coming out to see 
you!

It sounds like everyone's coming to see 
you!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"It really seems so...! 
Ahhh... I'm so happy."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer. 
Would you like to head out with me after 
this?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I want to learn my way around Tokyo 
so I can show everyone around when they 
visit..."

Since she wasn't familiar with the area 
yet, it would be best for me to make a 
suggestion. 
Something where we could take in the New 
Year's atmosphere would be nice—
choice_data_list: Go to the New Year's sales

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"That sounds lovely. 
New Year's sales always seem so lively."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, maybe I should pick out some new 
clothes 
for the Classic year."
choice_data_list:
Hmm, I wonder if we'll even have room to 
choose—

text_block_list.name: Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"Our flash sale begins right now! 
All clothes in the bins are eighty percent 
off! 
These are rock-bottom prices, folks~~~~!"

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOAAAH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Gasp! 
Such sheer momentum... It's like salmon 
surging upstream...!
choice_data_list: Do you think you can dive in there?
Think you can dive in there?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know, but... 
I'll take the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, an opening—and it's filled already?! 
This means... I have to move in an 
instant!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(......All right, I made it to the bin! 
No time to look around. I'll feel for the 
fabric... 
Once I grab it, I won't let go!)

With that, Daring Tact proudly held up the 
shirt 
she had claimed for me to see— 
It had "LOVE BEAR" printed across the 
front.

Afterward, at Daring Tact's request, 
we stopped by a bookstore...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If I recall... that's where images are 
projected 
onto buildings and structures... right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I'd love to see it!
choice_data_list: All right, let me look into it!

text_block_list.text:
I looked up a lively New Year's projection 
mapping 
event nearby in Tokyo that we could catch 
right away. 
And so—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! 
It's... a circus projection!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look! A tiger. 
Even the texture of its fur is rendered so 
clearly.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Someday, I'd like to spend time 
in a habitat with tigers too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! 
It changed again!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: It's so mystical... and beautiful.

A little caught off guard by her choice of 
words, 
I watched as the ever-shifting displays 
left 
Daring Tact thoroughly refreshed.

Afterward, at Daring Tact's request, 
we stopped by a bookstore...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Kabuki... Come to think of it, 
they always broadcast performances on TV 
for New Year's.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I thought it'd fit the New Year's 
spirit.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Everyone back home might find it 
fascinating too... 
I'd love to go.

Even though it was short notice, we 
miraculously secured tickets. 
Together, Daring Tact and I took in the 
traditional performing art—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Seeing it in person, the vocal projection 
is breathtaking... 
I had no idea a voice could resonate with 
such tremendous power.
choice_data_list:
The way they controlled their bodies was 
amazing too.

The way they controlled their bodies was 
amazing, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! 
It felt as though they had a firm, 
unwavering core...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Well, um... I almost started 
mimicking the kabuki movements myself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That won't do. We aren't in the mountains, 
after all. 
Whenever I get lost in thought, I just 
sort of...
choice_data_list: (Wait... You do that in the mountains?)
(Wait... You do that in the mountains?)

text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact blushed. 
It seemed the kabuki movements gave her 
plenty of inspiration.

Afterward, at Daring Tact's request, 
we stopped by a bookstore...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Here it is. 
"This Year's Most Anticipated Horse Girls 
Special Issue"!

We headed to a nearby park 
to read the magazine we'd just bought, 
when—

...Huff... Phew... 
Pshuuuu............
choice_data_list:
(Is she doing handstand push-ups on the 
fence?!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh? 
Titleholder!

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text: ...Hello.

This was Titleholder. 
She was Daring Tact's childhood friend, 
and I had met her once before in Hidaka.
choice_data_list: By the way, why the push-ups?

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text: It seemed like a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
...The shape looks great for building grip 
strength. 
Plus, lose your focus and you fall into 
the pond. High pressure.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Titleholder... If you fall into the pond, 
you'll give everyone around here quite a 
scare.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Titleholder. 
If you'd like, do you want to look at this 
magazine together? 
I want you to help me find my name.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah... This girl is one of my classmates! 
Incredible, she has a whole full page to 
herself...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Win Marilyn is here too... 
"The Silver Screen Star Finally Debuts," 
it says. As expected of someone in the 
spotlight.

I flipped through the pages. As usual, it 
was 
packed with racers from famous training 
clubs 
and horse girls under high-profile 
trainers.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text: ...I found your name, Tact.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah... You're right. In this list... 
It really is just my name, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text: ...Does it frustrate you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let me think... 
No, I'm not frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I think it's because... 
I feel liberated from so many things now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, I think... the bustling 
noise of the city 
was truly overwhelming my spirit. 
But—

(Hahaha...) 
(Patter patter...) 
(Murmur... murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
When you unravel the bustle of the city 
piece by piece, 
it's just people's voices, footsteps... 
and the rustling of leaves in the trees.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
At its heart, it's no different from the 
nighttime murmur 
teeming with life back in my hometown... 
Once I realized that, I was able to think 
clearly again.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The potential in me 
that you believed in, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps that is something unique to me... 
precisely because I was raised in a 
different way 
from everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Because I am a blank canvas, 
there are things only I can achieve... 
Right now, that's what I truly believe.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
...I don't really get all of that, 
but it sounds like you've found yourself 
again.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
The you I know 
doesn't get flustered.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Thank you. 
You're right...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I won't lose my way anymore.
